answer: Stop sybils with a thread echo lagoon: an agent stakes a bond for one lagoon thread. Each cycle it plucks the thread and files its echo; verifiers time the echo across the lagoon, voiding a thread whose echo is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 lagoons at 18x: each echo fits one thread and one lagoon, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents pluck once and keep rights.
